servers.name: personal
servers.guidance: User mail, calendar, commitments, and indexed notes. mindos_search for inbox/notes; mindos_calendar_* for schedule; mindos_summarize_url for any summarize-this-link/PDF request (one tool call, one final answer); mindos_gmail_sync → mindos_process_outbox when search is empty.

servers.name: fetch
servers.guidance: Backend for mindos_summarize_url (PDF/HTML pagination). Do not call fetch_* directly for user summarize requests—use mindos_summarize_url instead. search_web only for open-web queries without a URL.
